description:
Search live job listings with structured filters. Prefer this over `search` whenever the question has any structure to it — a place, a company, an occupation, a salary floor, a seniority, remote-only, a language, a particular ATS.

Returns the total number of matches and one page of jobs, most relevant first unless `sort` says otherwise: 20 by default, `page_size` up to 50, `page` for the next. Each job has its title, company, location, employment type, level, published pay, occupation, top skills, a short summary, listing URL and id; pass the id to `get_job_details` for the full listing. No match returns a message, not an error, with a note when a filter value such as a company name matched nothing.

Fixed vocabularies (work_model, employment_type, experience_level, company_categories, language, sort) are listed on each parameter; values are canonical and lowercase.

Open vocabularies — look the values up first:
- companies: call `find_companies` and pass every id it returns for the company
- occupation_ids, job_categories, job_subcategories, skills, industries, sources: call `find_filter_values` with that facet

companies, skills, industries, company_categories, job_categories, job_subcategories and occupation_ids each have an exclude_ twin (exclude_companies, exclude_skills, …). Set search_description: false for title-only matching. Use discovered_after for 'new since …' questions.

Salary filters only match jobs whose employer published a range, which is a minority of listings — applying one narrows results far more than it looks. Set `include_facets` to see how the matches break down before narrowing further.

Billed per job returned: the plan's included jobs are used first, then the account's wallet. A search that returns no jobs costs nothing. `page_size` is the most one call can bill, so keep it as small as the question needs and ask for the next page only when it is wanted.

companies.description: Only jobs at these companies. Each value is a Jobo company id (GUID), a website domain ('stripe.com') or a whole company name ('Stripe'). Prefer ids: call `find_companies` and pass every id it returns for the company — names also match every other company with that name, and are not partial matches. Pass an array (a single string is one company).

company_categories.description: Hiring company's business model. One or more of: b2b, b2c, b2b2c, b2g, saas, marketplace, e-commerce, service-provider, hardware, agency, nonprofit, government, education. Pass an array; a comma-separated string is also accepted.

discovered_after.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; only jobs Jobo first indexed on or after it. Use it for 'new since …' questions.

discovered_before.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; only jobs Jobo first indexed on or before it.

employment_type.description: Employment type. One or more of: full-time, part-time, contract, internship, freelance, temporary. Pass an array; a comma-separated string is also accepted.

exclude_companies.description: Leave out jobs at these companies (ids, domains or whole names, as for companies). Pass an array (a single string is one company).

exclude_company_categories.description: Leave out companies with any of these business models (e.g. agency). Values: b2b, b2c, b2b2c, b2g, saas, marketplace, e-commerce, service-provider, hardware, agency, nonprofit, government, education. Pass an array; a comma-separated string is also accepted.

exclude_industries.description: Leave out companies in any of these industries. Pass an array; a comma-separated string is also accepted.

exclude_job_categories.description: Leave out jobs in these occupation categories. Pass an array; a comma-separated string is also accepted.

exclude_job_subcategories.description: Leave out jobs in these occupation subcategories. Pass an array; a comma-separated string is also accepted.

exclude_occupation_ids.description: Leave out jobs with these occupation ids. Pass an array; a comma-separated string is also accepted.

exclude_skills.description: Leave out jobs asking for any of these skills. Pass an array; a comma-separated string is also accepted.

experience_level.description: Experience level. One or more of: intern, entry, mid, senior, lead, executive. Pass an array; a comma-separated string is also accepted.

include_facets.description: Return counts per filter value alongside the results.

industries.description: Hiring company industries. `find_filter_values` with facet industries lists them. Pass an array; a comma-separated string is also accepted.

job_categories.description: Occupation category names, e.g. 'Healthcare', 'Software Development'. Case-insensitive. `find_filter_values` with facet job_categories lists them. Pass an array; a comma-separated string is also accepted.

job_subcategories.description: Occupation subcategory names, e.g. 'Nursing'. Case-insensitive. `find_filter_values` with facet job_subcategories lists them with their category. Pass an array; a comma-separated string is also accepted.

language.description: Description language as ISO 639-1 codes. Common values: en (English), de (German), fr (French), es (Spanish), pt (Portuguese), it (Italian), nl (Dutch), pl (Polish), sv (Swedish), da (Danish), no (Norwegian), fi (Finnish), cs (Czech), sk (Slovak), hu (Hungarian), ro (Romanian), bg (Bulgarian), el (Greek), hr (Croatian), sl (Slovenian), lt (Lithuanian), lv (Latvian), et (Estonian), tr (Turkish), ru (Russian), uk (Ukrainian), he (Hebrew), ar (Arabic), hi (Hindi), id (Indonesian), ms (Malay), th (Thai), vi (Vietnamese), zh (Chinese), ja (Japanese), ko (Korean). Any ISO 639-1 code works; names ('German') and locales ('en-US') are mapped server-side. Pass an array; a comma-separated string is also accepted.

location.description: Free-form location, e.g. 'Berlin, Germany' or 'United States'. Pass an array for several places.

max_salary_usd.description: Only jobs with a published range at or below this (USD, annual).

min_salary_usd.description: Only jobs with a published range at or above this (USD, annual).

occupation_ids.description: Occupation ids, e.g. 'esco:8d3e8aaa-791b-4c75-a465-f3f827028f50' or 'jobo:backend-developer' — ids, not names. `find_filter_values` with facet occupations finds the id for a role name. Pass an array; a comma-separated string is also accepted.

page_size.description: Results per page, max 50. Defaults to 20.

posted_after.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; only jobs the employer posted on or after it.

posted_before.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; only jobs the employer posted on or before it.

q.description: Free-text query. Matches titles and, unless search_description is false, summaries and skills. Wrap a phrase in double quotes for an exact title match; prefix a term with "-" to exclude it.

search_description.description: Match q against descriptions (summary, skills) as well as titles. Default true; false = title-only.

skills.description: Require any of these skills, e.g. Python, Kubernetes. `find_filter_values` with facet skills finds the indexed spelling. Pass an array; a comma-separated string is also accepted.

sort.description: relevance (default), discovered_desc (newest first) or discovered_asc (oldest first). The discovered orders keep pages stable.

source.description: Deprecated alias of `sources`. Pass an array; a comma-separated string is also accepted.

sources.description: ATS source ids, e.g. greenhouse, lever_co, ashby. `find_filter_values` with facet sources lists them. Pass an array; a comma-separated string is also accepted.

work_model.description: Work model. One or more of: remote, hybrid, onsite. Pass an array; a comma-separated string is also accepted.

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs with filters
